name: vLLM
description: Models on a vLLM server you run, with their thinking switched through the chat template, and Whisper models for transcription.

provider.note: vLLM listens on port 8000 unless --port says otherwise; give it a key with --api-key, or leave the key empty.

chat.note: Add models with Fetch model list: each comes with the context the server holds. Tool calls need --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser <name>, and a model that thinks needs --reasoning-parser <name>; without them Shiori can't use her tools, and her thinking shows in her words.

transcription.note: For a Whisper model on a vLLM server of its own: give that server's address as this ability's own, and add the model by id.
